author: ISS Expedition 6 crew / NASA Johnson Space Center
why: 3032 × 2064 astronaut photograph explicitly catalogued as Aracar volcano, lake and salars. Taken with a 400 mm lens at a 37° tilt; archive confirms no annotations. High-resolution orbital alternative; image-file retrieval prevented independent sharpness verification.

author: NASA/JPL/UCSD/JSC
why: 3060 × 2036 EarthKAM photograph taken from the Space Shuttle on February 20, 2000. NASA explicitly identifies Aracar and its surrounding salt flats. Real camera photography; orbital landscape fallback, with final overlay and crop checks still needed.
